description: This file defines template classes for plugin monitoring and interface management within the WPEFramework. It includes classes for monitoring plugin activation/deactivation, managing interface pointers, and handling communication channels with plugins and controllers. The classes are designed to facilitate dynamic plugin interaction, especially in environments supporting hot-plugging or runtime interface changes.

classes.name: PluginHost::PluginMonitorType
classes.description: A template class that monitors plugin activation and deactivation events, providing interface access and notification handling.

classes.name: RPC::SmartInterfaceType
classes.description: A template class managing dynamic interaction with a plugin's interface via monitoring, suitable for non-plugin code.

classes.name: RPC::PluginSmartInterfaceType
classes.description: A template class managing plugin interfaces from within a plugin, handling activation/deactivation and interface access.

classes.name: RPC::SmartControllerInterfaceType
classes.description: A template class managing communication with a controller interface, handling connection lifecycle and interface querying.

methods.name: IsOperational
methods.description: Checks if the monitored plugin or interface is operational.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Sets the callsign used for plugin identification during registration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin or interface with the monitoring system.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin or interface from the monitoring system.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Returns the current interface pointer if available.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a plugin or controller at a specified network node.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a specific interface version from a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Callback invoked when the monitored plugin or interface's operational state changes.
